doors.note: EventON calendar page (WordPress). The HTML carries only empty calendar frames (class ajax_loading_cal) with their shortcode settings in data-sc, and a short-lived nonce in evo_general_params; no event text.

The plugin's own eventon_init_load call, replayed as a form POST (nonce + cals[<frame>][sc][…]) once for the page's own frames and once per later month (fixed_month / fixed_year / focus range stepped). The answer holds each calendar's rendered cards; every card carries a schema.org Event block with name, url, image, description and wall-clock start/end. The printed UTC offset is fixed and ignores daylight saving, so the wall clock is what is documented. The nonce lives about half a day: a stored page needs one fresh read first.

recon.notes: Recon from the scraper's own cached answers on 2026-09-20 (one page read, 4 POSTs). 2 cards across 2026-09, 2026-10, 2026-11, 2026-12: 2 on or after 2026-09-20 inside the window, 0 earlier this month, 0 past the window, 0 "CLOSED" day markers (notices, not events).

coverage.basis: Feed door: every card the calendar answers with, for each month to the scraper's horizon. Each night is its own card (the plugin pre-expands repeats), so every entry is a single. "CLOSED" markers are excluded as notices.
